newsitem.title: FINLAND: AHLSTROM SEES 1997 NET PROFIT UP ON 1996.
newsitem.headline: AHLSTROM SEES 1997 NET PROFIT UP ON 1996.

text.p: Privately owned Finnish engineering group A. Ahlstrom Oy said on Tuesday it expected full-year 1997 earnings before extras and tax to reach the same level as in 1996, but said net profit would be higher.
"The whole year's income before taxes and extraordinary items is expected to reach the previous year's level," Ahlstrom said in a statement with its January-April results.
"As no extaordinary expenses are foreseen, three will be an improvement in the net income for the fiscal year," it said.
In 1996, Ahlstrom's profit before extraordinary items and tax was 625.7 million markka, and net profit was 121.9 million markka, it said.
In January-April this year, Ahlstrom had earnings before extras and tax of 182.7 million markka, up from 108.5 million in the year-ago period.
"The delay in the investment decisions concerning the Asia-Pacific region will probably mean that the Ahlstrom Machinery Group's net sales will fall short of last year's figure," it said.
